The decline in profitability is clearly explained by higher operating expenses (S6-S7) and the absence of one-off gains present in the prior year (S8). Operational metrics show declines in volumes (S9-S10), investment decreased (S11), net finance costs decreased (S12), and balance sheet figures are provided (S13). The dividend distribution (S14) is a standalone event that does not contradict other statements. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition.
